content:
Since \(y^2-3y+6>0\) for all \(y\),

\[
S(y)=\frac{y^2-3y+6}{5}+\frac{y^2}{4}
=\frac{9}{20}y^2-\frac35y+\frac65.
\]

This quadratic has its minimum at

\[
y=\frac{3/5}{2(9/20)}=\frac23.
\]

Then

\[
S_{\min}=\frac{9}{20}\left(\frac23\right)^2-\frac35\left(\frac23\right)+\frac65
=\frac15-\frac25+\frac65=1.
\]

\[
\boxed{1}
\]
